title: Deoxyarbutin attenuates severe acute pancreatitis via the HtrA2/PGC-1alpha pathway.
authors: Li, Yangying; Zhu, Yuda; Li, Shiyi; Dong, Yuman; Wan, Chengyu; Yu, Xiuxian; Xin, Guang; Wei, Zeliang; Li, Fan; Wang, Yilan; Zhang, Kun; Chen, Qingqiu; Zhang, Cuicui; Wen, E; Niu, Hai; Huang, Wen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Deoxyarbutin通过HtrA2/PGC-1alpha通路缓解重症急性胰腺炎，核心为线粒体功能与自噬调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is an inflammatory disorder of the exocrine pancreas associated with high morbidity and mortality. SAP has been proven to trigger mitochondria dysfunction in the pancreas. We found that Deoxyarbutin (dA) recovered impaired mitochondrial function. High-temperature requirement protein A2 (HtrA2), a mitochondrial serine protease upstream of PGC-1alpha, is charge of quality control in mitochondrial homeostasis. The molecular docking study indicated that there was a potential interaction between dA and HtrA2. However, whether the protective effect of dA against SAP is regulated by HtrA2/PGC-1alpha remains unknown. Our study in vitro showed that dA significantly reduced the necrosis of primary acinar cells and reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, recovered mitochondrial membrane potential (DeltaPsim) and ATP exhaustion, while UCF-101 (HtrA2 inhibitor), and SR-18292 (PGC-1alpha inhibitor) eliminated the protective effect of dA. Moreover, HtrA2 siRNA transfection efficiently blocked the protective of dA on HtrA2/PGC-1alpha pathway in 266-6 acinar cells. Meanwhile, dA also decreased LC3II/I ration, as well as p62, and increased Parkin expression, while UCF-101 and Bafilomycin A1 (autophagy inhibitor) reversed the protective effect of dA. Our study in vivo confirmed that dA effectively alleviated severity of SAP by reducing pancreatic edema, plasma amylase, and lipase levels and improved the HtrA2/PGC-1alpha pathway. Therefore, this is the first study to identify that dA inhibits pancreatic injury caused by oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and impaired autophagy in a HtrA2/PGC-1alpha dependent manner.
abstract_zh: 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）是一种外分泌胰腺的炎症性疾病，与高发病率和死亡率相关。SAP已被证实会触发胰腺中的线粒体功能障碍。我们发现脱氧熊果苷（dA）能够恢复受损的线粒体功能。高温需求蛋白A2（HtrA2），一种位于PGC-1alpha上游的线粒体丝氨酸蛋白酶，负责线粒体稳态中的质量控制。分子对接研究表明，dA与HtrA2之间存在潜在相互作用。然而，dA对SAP的保护作用是否由HtrA2/PGC-1alpha调控仍不清楚。我们的体外研究表明，dA显著减少了原代腺泡细胞的坏死和活性氧（ROS）积累，恢复了线粒体膜电位（DeltaPsim）和ATP耗竭，而UCF-101（HtrA2抑制剂）和SR-18292（PGC-1alpha抑制剂）消除了dA的保护作用。此外，HtrA2 siRNA转染有效阻断了dA在266-6腺泡细胞中对HtrA2/PGC-1alpha通路的保护作用。同时，dA还降低了LC3II/I比值及p62，并增加了Parkin表达，而UCF-101和巴弗洛霉素A1（自噬抑制剂）逆转了dA的保护作用。我们的体内研究证实，dA通过减少胰腺水肿、血浆淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平，有效缓解了SAP的严重程度，并改善了HtrA2/PGC-1alpha通路。因此，这是首次研究确定dA以HtrA2/PGC-1alpha依赖方式抑制由氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和自噬受损引起的胰腺损伤。
